Changes: Added only a root translation for a top wall mount pivot. Native scale, original geometry, topology, normals, orientation and Flag/Wood/Metal materials retained. No replacement or approximation. Self-contained GLB; no textures, skins or animations.
Axes and mounting: Upright +Y; cloth hangs down -Y; width along X; front faces +Z. Origin is centered horizontally at the top of the metal caps (Y=0), with the rear bracket endpoint on the wall plane (Z=0). Point +Z away from the wall.
Dimensions (X/Y/Z): 1.126686763 / 2.354318162 / 0.322363432 m at native scale.
Geometry: 1 source mesh, 3 material primitives, 368 triangles, 284 vertices. Three.js loads the primitives as three mesh objects.
